skill.name: uiux-ops
skill.description: Provides UI/UX operations guidance for user-centered design, design systems, interaction states, and design documentation.
skill.summary: Guides consistent UI/UX reviews, design-system checks, and UIUX.md documentation.
skill.author: A-Genno

security_audit.summary: The static command findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code references to UIUX.md on lines 27 and 28. The entropy heuristic is also a false positive because SKILL.md is readable Markdown with Japanese text and no obfuscated payload. No semantic security findings or prompt injection attempts were found.

static_findings.snippet: - **詳細仕様**: UI/UX の詳細な設計指針・コンポーネント仕様は `UIUX.md` を参照
- **変更時の記録**: UI/UX に関わる設計判断・変更は必ず `UIUX.md` に記載・更新すること

static_findings.pattern: [HEURISTIC] High file entropy (6.65 bits) - possible binary/encrypted content

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 27 uses Markdown inline code to name UIUX.md as a reference document. It does not invoke a shell, interpolate input, or define executable Ruby code.
Line 28 uses Markdown inline code to name UIUX.md as a documentation target. There is no command execution behavior or command injection vector.
SKILL.md is readable Markdown with front matter and Japanese UI/UX guidance. I found no binary, encrypted, encoded, or concealed content.

content.value_statement: UI and UX work often loses consistency across screens, states, and decisions. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a concise checklist for design reviews and documentation.
actual_capabilities: Guides user-centered UI/UX planning with focus on goals, consistency, accessibility, and responsive behavior.
Structures design-system review across components, color palettes, typography, and spacing.
Reviews interaction design states such as feedback, errors, loading, and microinteractions.
Directs teams to document UI/UX specifications and design changes in UIUX.md.
Helps AI assistants produce checklists and review notes for interface improvements.
limitations: Does not include the referenced UIUX.md specification file.
Does not provide visual assets, mockups, or implementation code.
Does not validate WCAG compliance with automated tests.
Does not define product-specific brand rules or research data.

use_cases.title: Standardize design reviews
use_cases.description: Use the checklist to review screens for consistency, accessibility, responsive behavior, and interaction states.

use_cases.title: Check implementation readiness
use_cases.description: Review components, colors, typography, spacing, errors, and loading states before frontend development begins.

use_cases.title: Record design decisions
use_cases.description: Capture UI/UX rationale and changes in UIUX.md so product and delivery teams share one reference.

prompt_templates.title: Review a screen
prompt_templates.prompt: Use uiux-ops to review this screen description for user goals, consistency, accessibility, and responsive behavior: [screen details].

prompt_templates.title: Create a design checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a UI/UX checklist for [feature] using component, color, typography, spacing, feedback, error, and loading considerations.

prompt_templates.title: Plan UIUX.md updates
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft concise UIUX.md updates for [change]. Include design rationale, affected components, interaction states, and follow-up checks.

prompt_templates.title: Run a cross-flow audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [workflow] across desktop and mobile. Identify inconsistencies in components, states, accessibility, responsive layout, and documentation gaps.

output_examples.input: Review a checkout form for mobile readiness.
output_examples.output: The review highlights missing loading feedback after payment, inconsistent error text, cramped spacing, and unclear keyboard behavior.

output_examples.input: Prepare UIUX.md notes for a new settings panel.
output_examples.output: The notes summarize component choices, color usage, typography rules, interaction states, and the reason for the design change.

output_examples.input: Create a design-system checklist for a dashboard.
output_examples.output: The checklist covers reusable cards, semantic colors, heading hierarchy, spacing rules, responsive layouts, error states, and documentation tasks.

best_practices: Start each review with the user's primary goal and success criteria.
Check components, colors, typography, and spacing against the same design system.
Record design decisions and UI changes in UIUX.md during the same workflow.
anti_patterns: Reviewing visual polish without checking error, loading, and feedback states.
Changing interface patterns without documenting the reason and affected components.
Treating desktop layouts as complete without testing smaller screens.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps AI assistants review UI/UX work through design principles, system checks, interaction states, and documentation practices.

faq.question: Does it generate finished interface designs?
faq.answer: No. It provides process guidance and review checklists, not finished mockups or production assets.

faq.question: Can it support accessibility work?
faq.answer: Yes. It prompts reviewers to consider WCAG alignment and inclusive access, but it does not run automated accessibility tests.

faq.question: Why does it mention UIUX.md?
faq.answer: The skill treats UIUX.md as the central place for design specifications, decisions, and change records.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The skill is declared for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it replace user research?
faq.answer: No. It can organize design reviews, but teams still need real user research and product context.
